roles.title: Backend Developer 💻
roles.description: I work with Java, JavaScript, and C++ to build reliable backend systems. Love optimizing performance and making things run smoothly. Currently solving interesting problems with distributed systems and caching.

roles.title: Full Stack Engineer 🔧
roles.description: From React frontends to Spring Boot APIs, I enjoy building complete solutions. I've worked on projects serving thousands of users and learned a lot from both successes and failures along the way.

roles.title: Continuous Learner 📚
roles.description: Always curious about new tech and better ways to solve problems. I've tackled 1500+ coding challenges, published some research, and I'm constantly experimenting with new tools and frameworks.

projects.name: E-Commerce Beast 🛒⚡
projects.description: A comprehensive e-commerce backend system built with Java and Spring Boot. Features include product management, order processing, and a custom message broker for handling asynchronous operations. Implemented with Docker for containerization and includes monitoring with Prometheus and Redis for caching.

projects.name: Chat App 💬
projects.description: A real-time chat application built with the MERN stack and Socket.io. Features instant messaging, user authentication, and a clean interface. Great learning experience working with websockets and real-time data.

projects.name: Food Delivery App 🍕
projects.description: A full-stack food delivery application with user authentication, cart management, and payment gateway integration. Built using the MERN stack with Redux for state management. Focused on creating a smooth user experience from browsing to checkout.
